title: Oven temp probe open
fullDescription: Imperial commercial range/oven detected an open RTD on the cavity sensor. Heating disabled.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and reseat probe connector.

faq.a: Affects oven section only; burners still light.

title: Probe shorted
fullDescription: RTD reads low resistance, indicating short. Replace probe.

title: High temperature
fullDescription: Hi-limit fired. Stuck gas valve or failed probe causing runaway.

fixSteps.title: Shut gas
fixSteps.instruction: Close gas shutoff and let cool.

title: Ignition lockout
shortDescription: Burner failed to light after retries.
fullDescription: Spark module locked out after failing to detect flame. Reset and check gas.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas
fixSteps.instruction: Open gas valve, check other appliances.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech cleans pilot and tests ignitor.

title: Convection blower fault
shortDescription: Blower not running on convection oven model.
fullDescription: Convection blower failed to spin. Check capacitor or motor on convection range model.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech tests capacitor, replaces motor if needed.

title: Door switch fault
fullDescription: Door reported open mid-cycle. Check latch and reed switch.

title: Gas pressure switch fault
shortDescription: Gas pressure too low or switch open.
fullDescription: Pressure switch did not prove gas pressure. Check supply or switch.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech measures inlet pressure and replaces switch.

faq.a: 5-7 in WC NG, 11-13 in WC LP.

title: Communication error
fullDescription: Display board cannot reach the main board. Reseat and replace if needed.

title: Memory error
fullDescription: EEPROM checksum error after surge. Factory reset and reprogram.
